name: Ice Flurry
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: The paint was obtainable by reaching the 95th tier of the January 2020 challenges.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
If you stack 3 tanks wearing this paint on top of each other, you can create one of the most intimidating snowmen in the world.

Interesting facts
The paint was obtainable by reaching the 95th tier of the January 2020 challenges.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
If you stack 3 tanks wearing this paint on top of each other, you can create one of the most intimidating snowmen in the world.
